claim.claim-text: 1. An information reporting method, applied to user equipment (10) and comprising:

3. The method according to claim 1, wherein the RRC Resume Request message is sent by the user equipment (10) when RNA update conditions are met; the first RRC message is sent on the condition that the network device (120) judges the list of PLMN of cell broadcast to be restored excludes RPLMN of the user equipment (10).
4. The method according to claim 1, wherein the second cause value is set as mo-singalling or mo-data.
5. The method according to claim 2, wherein the RRC release message is used to keep the user equipment (10) in the inactive mode.
6. The method according to claim 1, further comprising: entering an RRC connected mode.
7. An information receiving method, applied to a network device (120) and comprising:

9. The method according to claim 7, wherein the RRC Resume Request message is sent by the user equipment (10) when RNA update conditions are met; and the first RRC message is sent on the condition that the network device judges the list of PLMN of cell broadcast to be restored excludes RPLMN of the user equipment (10).
10. The method according to claim 7, wherein the second cause value is set as mo-singalling or mo-data.
11. The method according to claim 8, wherein the RRC release message is used to keep the user equipment (10) in the inactive mode.
12. The method according to claim 7, wherein the RRC Resume Request message is used to enable the user equipment (10) to enter an RRC connected state.

13. User equipment (1400), comprising a memory (1409), a processor (1410), and a program stored in the memory (1409) and executable on the processor (1410), wherein the program, when executed by the processor (1410), implements steps of the information reporting method according to any one of claims 1 to 6.

14. A network device (150), comprising a memory (156), a processor (155), and a program stored in the memory (156) and executable on the processor (155), wherein the program, when executed by the processor (155), implements steps of the information reporting method according to any one of claims 7 to 12.

15. A computer readable storage medium, storing a computer program, characterized in that when the computer program is executed by a processor, the information reporting method according to any one of claims 1 to 6 is implemented, or the information receiving method according to any one of claims 7 to 12 is implemented.
